component.name: PlayerScene
component.script:
sub init() print "PLAYER INIT"
m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.dbg = m.top.findNode("dbg")
m.top.observeField("boundingRect", "onResize") onResize()
m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged") m.video.observeField("state", "onState") m.video.observeField("errorMsg", "onErr") m.video.observeField("errorCode", "onErr")
' Ensure keys m.top.setFocus(true) m.video.setFocus(true)
' Default behavior: do not loop unless placeholder m.video.repeat = false end sub
sub onResize() ' Fixed dimensions for 1080p m.bg.width = 1920 m.bg.height = 1080 m.video.width = 1920 m.video.height = 1080 end sub
sub onContentChanged() item = m.top.content if item = invalid then m.dbg.visible = true m.dbg.text = "PLAYER: no content" return end if
url = safeStr(item.url).trim() fmt = safeStr(item.streamFormat).trim() if fmt = "" then fmt = "mp4"
' Loop placeholders so playback never feels broken isPlaceholder = false if item.id <> invalid then if LCase(item.id).instr("placeholder") >= 0 then isPlaceholder = true end if
if isPlaceholder = true then m.video.repeat = true else m.video.repeat = false end if
if url = "" then m.dbg.visible = true m.dbg.text = "PLAYER: missing URL" return end if
m.dbg.visible = true m.dbg.text = "PLAYER: loading\nURL: " + url + "\nFMT: " + fmt + "\nBack to exit"
cn = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") cn.url = url cn.title = safeStr(item.title) cn.streamFormat = fmt cn.contentType = "movie" cn.mimeType = "video/mp4"
m.video.control = "stop" m.video.content = cn m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onState() st = m.video.state print "VIDEO STATE=" + st
if st = "playing" then m.dbg.visible = false else m.dbg.visible = true m.dbg.text = "PLAYER: " + st + "\nBack to exit" end if
' IMPORTANT: do NOT auto-close on finished ' (auto-close causes the half-second flash behavior) end sub
sub onErr() msg = m.video.errorMsg code = m.video.errorCode if msg = invalid or msg = "" then msg = "Playback error"
m.dbg.visible = true m.dbg.text = "PLAYER: ERROR\nCode: " + code.toStr() + "\n" + msg + "\nBack to exit" print "VIDEO ERROR code="; code; " msg="; msg end sub
sub requestClose() m.top.closeRequested = not m.top.closeRequested end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "back" then m.video.control = "stop" requestClose() return true end if
return false end function
function safeStr(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "" return v.toStr() end function
